headline: Recommended approval, with conditions, of an expanded all-alcoholic liquor license at 1295 Liberty Street.
summary: Two people spoke in favor of the request, and none spoke against it. The petitioner is Ivys Events, LLC. The conditions require hours of operation as listed on the application and no banners, streamers, pennants, or promotional materials on the exterior of the property.
decisions: Recommended approval, with conditions, of an all-alcoholic liquor license expansion at 1295 Liberty Street, 6-0.

decision_titles: All-alcoholic liquor license expansion at 1295 Liberty Street
plain_text:
ROLL CALL:  
 
Present: six (6): Mr. Daniele, Ms. McQuade, Mr. Milette, Ms. Morin, Ms. Ford and Mr. 
Cunningham   
Absent: one (1): Mr. Mineo  
 
PUBLIC HEARING:  
 
Liquor License:  
 
1. All-Alcoholic Liquor License (Expansion)  
Location: 1295 Liberty Street  
Petitioner: Ivys Events, LLC  
 
SPEAKING IN FAVOR: TWO (2)  
SPEAKING AGAINST: ZERO (0)  
 
MOTION: APPROVE 
 
IN FAVOR: six (6): Mr. Daniele, Ms. McQuade, Mr. Milette, Ms. Morin, Ms. Ford and Mr. 
Cunningham   
OPPOSED: zero (0)  
ABSTAINED:  N/A  
RECOMMENDATION: APPROVE, WITH CONDITIONS 
 
CONDITIONS:  
1. The hours of operation shall be as listed on the application. 
2. There shall be no banners, streamers, pennants, or promotional materials located on 
the exterior of the property. 
 
ALL OTHER MATTERS PROP ERLY  BEFORE THE BOARD  
MEETING MINUTES SUMMARY  
Date:  November 18, 2026 
Time:   6:00PM  
Location:  36 Court Street, Room 220, City Hall
